purpose: Determine whether the accumulated post-v0.1.0 scientific-core, reproducibility, System Dynamics governance and repository-governance work constitutes a coherent public scientific-core milestone suitable for v0.2.0 without implying model completion or behavioural validation.
substantive_changes_since_v0_1_0: Completed validation-recovery and source-boundary adjudication under explicit evidence-triggered reopen governance.
Advanced reference-mode observability to 9/10 while retaining sectoral_financial_positions as an explicit blocker.
Expanded and froze instrument-specific Accounting Spine rank/materialisation/reopen boundaries without synthetic bilateral allocation.
Completed link-level structural review of all five registered feedback structures, preserving four closed candidate loops and one open FX chain with zero quantitative activation.

Added machine-checkable endogenous/exogenous node boundaries, exact-link readiness, delay evidence, activation criteria, dimensional/parameter semantics, robustness and System Dynamics conformity gates.
Added retained official source vintages, offline provenance verification, scientific-baseline integration/consolidation governance and trigger-aware monitoring.
Formalized numerical-integration structural convergence and time-step adequacy without claiming integrated behavioural-model numerical validation.
Professionalized README, contributor/support surfaces, release/version governance and repository documentation.

release_classification.rationale: The change set is substantially broader than a corrective patch, while RMD remains in initial development and does not claim a stable 1.0 public model API or completed endogenous behavioural reference model.

scientific_nonclaims: v0.2.0 does not mean the Accounting Spine is complete.
v0.2.0 does not mean sectoral_financial_positions is ready.
v0.2.0 does not validate a behavioural reference mechanism.
v0.2.0 does not activate any System Dynamics feedback loop.
v0.2.0 does not activate behavioural closure.
v0.2.0 is not a calibrated forecasting or policy-simulation release.
